item.title: Wakusei Omega no Q Ouji
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Twinkle
  • 発売日: 1996-09-12
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 惑星ΩのＱ王子
  • 英語名: Wakusei Omega no Q Ouji

あらすじ

Space explorers from Earth discovered a strange cosmic object: a giant pumpkin nearing the planet. Upon establishing contact with the pumpkin, they discovered that this vessel belonged to Prince Q from the planet Omega. The planet’s super-computer (with a powerful 4 MhZ processor) determined that the prince has to get married. In order to do that, he has to descend onto Earth and find a suitable candidate - naturally after having conducted a thorough sexual examination.

item.title: Mime
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Twinkle
  • 発売日: 1995-09-29
  • スコア: 6.74/10 (6 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 舞夢
  • 英語名: Mime

あらすじ

Once upon a time, there was harmony and balance in the world. Four kingdoms of humans have watched over the four elements. But then a traitor appeared, who has angered the Goddess with his selfish deeds. The balance was destroyed, the elements were no more in harmony, and the world plunged into chaos…

Twelve thousand years later, a young knight named Eagle Windeed has been having a strange dream. Maybe there is still salvation for the human race. Maybe it is still possible to make peace with the higher beings. Eagle arrives at a tavern near the Tree Dungeon, determined to find out what his dream meant…

item.title: Twilight
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Twinkle
  • 発売日: 1994-05-14
  • スコア: 5.8/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: トワイライト
  • 英語名: Twilight

あらすじ

The protagonist belongs to the dark cult of magic-users. Not long ago sister Christa betrayed the cult and was eliminated. But there is a possibility that she got some disciples among students of monastery school somewhere in Transylvania, where she was a teacher.

The protagonist set off to that academy to find and brainwash potential disciples of sister Christa and erase her legacy once and for all.

item.title: Bunretsu Shugoshin Twinkle☆Star
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Twinkle
  • 発売日: 1993-07-29
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 分裂守護神トゥインクル☆スター
  • 英語名: Bunretsu Shugoshin Twinkle☆Star

别名

  • Division Guardian‛： Twinkle-Star

あらすじ

The hero of the game, a high-school student named Touma, has a strange dream, in which he is a hero, a savior of the world in a parallel dimension. And now he is dying, having sacrificed his life for a beautiful woman whom he calls Ruby. Touma wakes up, unable to understand anything, and suddenly realizes it was not a dream… at least not entirely. A magical symbol is engraved on his forehead. Touma realizes that he will have to learn more about his heroic destiny. Meanwhile, a young, seductive English teacher arrives at his school…

item.title: Mirror
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Studio Twinkle
  • 発売日: 1992-12-09
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 鏡 －ｍｉｒｒｏｒ－
  • 英語名: Mirror

别名

  • Kagami

あらすじ

One day, a certain young man notices a little shop labeled “Mirror”. When he enters, he encounters a strange, puppet-like woman who calls herself Heine. She shows the young man a puppet that looks like a beautiful young woman, and asks him to touch it. Immediately afterwards, the hero finds himself in a hospital, suffering from amnesia and facing an unknown woman who looks exactly like the puppet. Now he has to find out the truth behind this strange story, and separate dream from reality.
